fact.subject: NVIDIA
fact.object: 五家英国 AI 创业公司

evidence.quote: Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Boltz, Foresight, Hiverge, Prima Mente and Riverlane.

Boltz, a London-based AI startup founded by MIT researchers, builds biomolecular models and AI agents that help scientists predict molecular structures and interactions, and design potential new medicines.
NVIDIA is putting that principle into practice, including through a five-year, $250 million compute commitment to strengthen the U.K.’s agentic safety and security research.

title: From Enterprise to Earthshot: UK’s Ecosystem Moves From Ambition to Application With NVIDIA
displayTitle: NVIDIA 公布五家英国 AI 初创投资计划，安全算力承诺仍待兑现
summary: NVIDIA 10 月 14 日公布计划投资 Boltz、Foresight、Hiverge、Prima Mente、Riverlane 五家英国初创企业，并提及五年期 2.5 亿美元英国 AI 安全研究算力承诺。文章没有披露各笔投资金额或完成条件。
investorNote: 芯片平台通过资本、算力和生态伙伴捆绑应用公司，投资计划与实际出资须分开观察。
narrative: NVIDIA 公布计划投资五家英国 AI 初创企业，覆盖生物分子建模、项目预测、算法发现等方向；文章同时提到五年期 2.5 亿美元英国 AI 安全研究算力承诺。各笔投资金额和交割条件没有披露，因此现阶段更适合视为生态布局信号。算力供应商通过资本连接下游应用的趋势更清楚了，但实际投入与商业收入仍要分别追踪。

eventRelation.reason: 本期新报道的独立动作，近两周记录中无可确认的同次发生。
